result.topic_en: Geometric figures of hexagons inscribed in a circle with intersecting triangles, together with tables of angles and side quantities around a point 0 and formulas for the sines of angle differences in terms of $r$ and $\varrho$.
result.transcription:
[Figure: circle with inscribed hexagon (dotted) and two intersecting triangles]
[Figure: circle with points 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and interior point o; triangles 1-2-3 and 6-4-5]

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 0 & 180-\mathfrak{B} & \ldots \\ 1 & \mathfrak{B}-B & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\gamma} \\ 6 & B & \alpha \end{array}$
$\frac{2\alpha r}{b}$

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 0 & 180-\mathfrak{B} & \ldots \\ 4 & B & \gamma \\ 3 & \mathfrak{B}-B & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\alpha} \end{array}$
$\frac{2\gamma r}{b}$

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 0 & 180-\mathfrak{A} & \ldots \\ 6 & A & \mathfrak{b} \\ 2 & \mathfrak{A}-A & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\gamma} \end{array}$
$\frac{2\mathfrak{b}r}{a}$

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 0 & 180-\mathfrak{A} & \ldots \\ 3 & \mathfrak{A}-A & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\mathfrak{b}} \\ 5 & A & \gamma \end{array}$
$\frac{2\gamma r}{a}$

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 6 & 180-\mathfrak{C} & \ldots \\ 2 & \mathfrak{C}-C & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\alpha} \\ 4 & C & \mathfrak{b} \end{array}$
$\frac{2\mathfrak{b}r}{c}$

$\begin{array}{c|c|c} 0 & 180-\mathfrak{C} & \ldots \\ 5 & C & \alpha \\ 1 & \mathfrak{C}-C & \frac{rr-\varrho\varrho}{\mathfrak{b}} \end{array}$
$\frac{2\alpha r}{c}$

$\sin \mathfrak{A}-A = \frac{a(rr-\varrho\varrho)}{2\mathfrak{b}\gamma r}$
$\sin \mathfrak{B}-B = \frac{b(rr-\varrho\varrho)}{2\gamma\alpha r}$
$\sin \mathfrak{C}-C = \frac{c(rr-\varrho\varrho)}{2\alpha\mathfrak{b} r}$

methods.what: Triangles formed by the interior point 0 and two points on the circle, tabulated by angles and sides; the side opposite the angle at 0 is computed as a chord ratio
Power of the point 0 with respect to the circle: the product of the two segments of a chord through 0 equals $r^2-\varrho^2$
Formulas for the sines of the angle differences in terms of the sides, the circle radius $r$ and the distance $\varrho$ of the point from the centre
Analogous sine formula for the angle difference at B
Analogous sine formula for the angle difference at C
